rationale: Operator ruling via decision rubric 2026-10-31. Problem: AISDLC-1123 added a pre-push step running the deterministic CI governance checks (conflict markers, waived-tests, reviewers when an envelope is in the range, backlog-drift only when a backlog-referenced file is removed, gate tests only when a gate directory changed) and the shrink-only registry needs a decision id. Ruling: register. The step calls the same scripts with the same arguments CI passes, each conditional on the push range, so it is one standard enforced early (seconds per push), not a second standard; CI remains the only check that blocks a merge. The removed-file drift shape it catches is the one that turned every open PR red on 2026-10-31 (#2203). Counter-argument weighed: DEC-0056 row 3 deleted the push-time drift check as friction and every hook step adds a skip variable; rebuttal: that check ran full drift on every push, this one runs it only on the removed-file shape, and the skip variable falls under the never-routine rule. Condition: the gates.yaml property line for pre-push:scripts/check-governance-on-push.sh wrongly lists 'attestation verify', which stays in the fixups step (AISDLC-694); it is corrected by follow-up task AISDLC-1134 together with the DEC-0282 doc fixes. Rejected: skip/remove (CI round-trip per governance slip), cheap-scans-only (gate directories change rarely and the gate tests protect the registry itself), register-as-written (registry would misdescribe a control).
